# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Curio is pre-1.0 (`v0.1.0`). Only the latest release is supported — please upgrade before reporting an issue.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, email **edersoares@me.com** with a description of the issue and steps to reproduce it. You should expect an initial response within a few days. Once the issue is confirmed, a fix will be released as soon as reasonably possible, and you'll be credited in the release notes unless you prefer otherwise.
